# named `nightly`: assets and the single appcast item are clobbered in place each run, so no
# per-day tags accumulate. The release TITLE holds the resolved version ("<base>-nightly.<count>")
# and doubles as the "already built this commit" marker for the skip guard — it is written only
# after assets + appcast publish succeed, so a partial run retries next time instead of skipping.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 5 * * *" # daily ~05:00 UTC (5am GMT)
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

# Serialize with the release + appcast-notes workflows: all three download-modify-upload the same
# appcast.xml, so overlapping runs could drop items. Queue rather than cancel.
concurrency:
  group: appcast-feed
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # Decide whether there's anything new to build, and compute the nightly version. Base rule:
  # incpatch(latest reachable tag) — a prerelease tag targets its own release (v2.0.0-beta.21 →
  # 2.0.0), a stable tag bumps patch (v1.3.0 → 1.3.1). The commit count is the monotonic ordering
  # key the CLI + Sparkle compare on.
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      should_build: ${{ steps.guard.outputs.should_build }}
      version: ${{ steps.guard.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # rev-list --count + tag discovery need full history

      - id: guard
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # --match 'v*' skips the floating `nightly` release tag (retagged to HEAD
          # each run), which would otherwise win git describe and break parsing.
          LATEST="$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 --match 'v*' 2>/dev/null || echo v0.0.0)"
          RAW="${LATEST#v}"; RAW="${RAW%%+*}"   # strip leading v + any build metadata
          CORE="${RAW%%-*}"                      # MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
          if [ "$RAW" != "$CORE" ]; then
            BASE="$CORE"                         # prerelease latest → target that release line
          else
            MAJOR="${CORE%%.*}"; TMP="${CORE#*.}"; MINOR="${TMP%%.*}"; PATCH="${TMP#*.}"
            BASE="${MAJOR}.${MINOR}.$((PATCH + 1))"  # stable latest → bump patch
          fi
          COUNT="$(git rev-list --count HEAD)"
          VERSION="${BASE}-nightly.${COUNT}"
          echo "version=${VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Computed nightly version: ${VERSION}"

          PUBLISHED="$(gh release view nightly --json name -q .name 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
          PUB_COUNT="${PUBLISHED##*-nightly.}"
          if [ "${PUB_COUNT}" = "${COUNT}" ]; then
            echo "No new commits since nightly build ${COUNT}; skipping."
            echo "should_build=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "should_build=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      VERSION: ${{ needs.check.outputs.version }}
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    steps:

      - uses: maxim-lobanov/setup-xcode@v1
        with:
          xcode-version: latest-stable

      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Install XcodeGen + create-dmg + protobuf
        run: brew install xcodegen create-dmg protobuf

      # Separate step, and deliberately non-fatal — unlike the release workflow, which installs
      # sentry-cli on the same fatal brew line. This job is an unattended cron: a Homebrew/tap hiccup
      # must cost tonight's SYMBOLS, never tonight's BUILD. `release.sh` already skips the upload when
      # the CLI is missing, and the warning below surfaces the degraded night on the run summary.
      - name: Install sentry-cli (optional — dSYM upload)
        run: |
          brew install getsentry/tools/sentry-cli \
            || echo "::warning::sentry-cli unavailable; nightly will ship without symbol upload"

      - name: Add Rust darwin targets (universal VCS core)
        run: rustup target add x86_64-apple-darwin aarch64-apple-darwin

      - name: Import Developer ID signing certificate
        env:
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PWD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PWD }}
          KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          CERT="$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-id.p12"
          KEYCHAIN="$RUNNER_TEMP/app-signing.keychain-db"
          echo "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE" | openssl base64 -d -A > "$CERT"
          security create-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN"
          security set-keychain-settings -lut 21600 "$KEYCHAIN"
          security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN"
          security import "$CERT" -P "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PWD" -A -t cert -f pkcs12 -k "$KEYCHAIN"
          security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple: -k "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN"
          security list-keychain -d user -s "$KEYCHAIN" login.keychain

      # Gate the nightly on the suite that guards the ARTIFACT — the bundled-resource checksum
      # tripwires and the universal-arch cases. Runs BEFORE the release step, or it is not a gate.
      #
      # `make app-release` cannot depend on this itself: app-test builds Debug, which pins automatic
      # "Apple Development" signing (project.yml), and this runner imports only a Developer ID cert.
      # Hence the same ad-hoc overrides ci.yml uses.
      - name: Test (artifact gate)
        run: >-
          make app-test
          APP_SIGN_FLAGS="CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=YES DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="

      - name: Build, sign, notarize, staple, package DMG
        env:
          NOTARY_KEY: ${{ secrets.NOTARY_KEY }}
          NOTARY_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.NOTARY_KEY_ID }}
          NOTARY_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.NOTARY_ISSUER_ID }}
          SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Sentry dSYM upload (optional — release.sh skips when any is empty). Without these the
          # nightly shipped unsymbolicated every night, which is why the app frames in WORKROOM-2B's
          # hang report were three unnamed addresses. ORG/PROJECT are slugs, not secrets, but kept as
          # secrets to match this job's convention (and release.yml's).
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
          # release.sh derives MARKETING_VERSION = ${VERSION#v} and CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION = commit
          # count; the nightly version has no leading v, so it flows through unchanged.
        run: |
          echo "$NOTARY_KEY" | openssl base64 -d -A > "$RUNNER_TEMP/notary.p8"
          # CONFIGURATION=Nightly builds the side-by-side "Workroom Nightly" identity (bundle id,
          # name, icon, pinned nightly channel) instead of the main "Workroom" app.
          CONFIGURATION=Nightly NOTARY_KEY_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/notary.p8" make app-release

      - name: Upload nightly DMG
        run: |
          # Fixed, version-independent name so the appcast enclosure URL is stable across nights.
          ASSET="$RUNNER_TEMP/workroom-macos-app_nightly.dmg"
          cp "macapp/build/release/Workroom Nightly.dmg" "$ASSET"
          gh release upload nightly "$ASSET" --clobber

      - name: Publish Sparkle appcast (nightly channel)
        env:
          TAG: nightly
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: macapp/Scripts/appcast.sh

      - name: Stamp nightly release with the version (skip marker)
        # LAST step: written only after assets + appcast succeed, so a partial run retries.
        run: gh release edit nightly --title "${VERSION}"
